grammarly-teal.$description: Grammarly Teal — Primary buttons, links, active nav, dark enterprise hero bands, decorative icon strokes — a deep botanical teal that reads as both professional and approachable against white and near-black surfaces

midnight-navy.$description: Midnight Navy — Headings, navigation text, body copy, card text, icon strokes, footer copy — the dominant dark color carrying nearly all prose

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Display headings, high-emphasis body text, link text — slightly cooler/deeper than Midnight Navy, used for the heaviest type

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted body text, secondary button labels, helper copy, icon strokes

steel.$description: Steel — Tertiary text, disabled labels, low-emphasis metadata

silver.$description: Silver — Disabled borders, placeholder icons, very low-emphasis strokes

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders, subtle dividers, input rest states

fog.$description: Fog — Lighter hairline borders, checkbox outlines, secondary dividers

cloud.$description: Cloud — Subtle surface backgrounds, hover washes, secondary panels

carbon.$description: Carbon — Dark surface fills for footer or alternate bands — warmer than Ink Black

slate.$description: Slate — Button hover states, secondary icon tinting, muted UI chrome

paper.$description: Paper — Primary page background, card surfaces, button text on teal

glyph.$description: Primary UI and body typeface — a custom humanist sans with wider proportions and more open apertures than matter. Weight 400 for body, nav, buttons, labels; 700 for emphasis and subheadings. The 1.45 line-height is generous for reading comfort at 16px body size.

matter.$description: Display and heading typeface — a custom geometric grotesque with a slight humanist warmth. Weight 670 (between bold and black) gives headlines visual weight without becoming heavy; the -0.0100em tracking and tight 1.09 line-height create a compressed, editorial feel. Used for h1–h3 and large stat numbers.

inter.$description: Secondary body in card contexts — appears in product UI cards and embedded components

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
